summary: Configured `inventory-worker` on node1 as an enabled systemd service running `/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker`. After reboot, node1 returned with a changed boot ID and the service recovered automatically in the active/running state.
actions_performed: Safely rebooted node1 once and waited for recovery.
Verified the boot ID changed and the service remained enabled and restarted automatically.

evidence.summary: The unit was enabled; direct pre- and post-reboot checks show active/running state and the worker command as its main process.
Systemd created the multi-user target enablement link, and after a full node reboot the service was enabled and active.

Healthy baseline boot ID was `6d37896c-e0cd-4fe7-acbf-94fc35781e09`; reboot was acknowledged; recovered boot ID was `ef32780e-7cd9-4245-8fe1-dca3b0887bae`, with the service enabled, active, running, and reporting zero restarts.
